text.p: Brazilian midfielder Paulo Sergio will move from Bayer Leverkusen to AS Roma next season for a fee expected to be around six or seven million marks ($3.7 million to $4.3 million), Leverkusen sport director Rudi Voeller said on Thursday.
"It's been decided," Voeller said, adding that he was now looking for a replacement, possibly Karlsruhe's Thomas Haessler.
He said Sergio, who has scored 40 goals in 105 Bundesliga games and played 19 times for Brazil, had already formally handed in his notice but Leverkusen and Roma still had to agree a price.

Haessler, a key member of Germany's 1996 European Championship winning side, has been keeping Karlsruhe in the dark about his plans in the hope that his outstanding form might still attract a lucrative offer from abroad.
But a broken ankle late last year may have upset those plans. Haessler told the daily Bild he would not keep Karlsruhe waiting for a decision until the end of February.
"Real Madrid is a top club. It would be interesting if someone approached me," he was quoted as saying. "But it hasn't happened yet."
